reason: The cited evidence shows that force-constant disorder is a dominant phonon scattering source in HEAs (E2) and that Green–Kubo with MLFF can yield converged lattice thermal conductivity (E3), but it provides no support for the claimed quantitative improvement, the specific temperature-dependent features, or the ability of DFT+Boltzmann transport to cleanly separate electronic contributions in this alloy.
premises: DFT and Boltzmann transport can accurately separate electronic thermal conductivity in HfNbTaTiZr
ML-trained force fields capture force-constant disorder and phonon scattering in this HEA
